subject: POC extension options — top-up voucher vs fixed time extension
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex@lumigen.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Gupta <priya@lumigen.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Request: short pilot extension or credit for burst testing

Hi Sofia,

First, thanks — the team has gotten useful signal from the demo. We hit a blocker finishing our throughput checks because the production connector we planned to use got delayed; that means we won't generate the expected token volume before the pilot end date (Dec 10).

Two asks: can we either (A) get a 3-week time extension to complete the final integration and run the burst tests, or (B) get a voucher/credit equivalent to ~150k infer tokens so we can run an accelerated window once the connector is live? Finance prefers credits (option B) but engineering would rather have the extra time (option A).

Quick context: the evaluation is focused on latency under client-like traffic patterns and reranker stability. We have approval to move to procurement if the evaluation shows expected improvements.

Could you outline cost/packaging for both options and what the operational impacts would be (quota changes, SLOs, engineering support)? Also, if we go with credits, can you provide an addendum so procurement has something to sign?

Thanks — Alex
Alex Chen
CTO, Lumigen
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex@lumigen.com>
Cc: Priya Gupta <priya@lumigen.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: short pilot extension or credit for burst testing

Hi Alex — thanks for the note and context. Sorry to hear the connector delay — we can support either path. High-level options below; attaching a short scenarios doc with numbers (POC_TopUp_Scenarios.pdf).

Option A — 3-week time extension (no credits)
- Dates: extend pilot from Dec 10 to Dec 31
- Pricing: no additional usage charge for baseline included seats; if usage during extension exceeds the pilot cap we’ll bill overage at the trial rate (0.0006 $/token for reranker workloads)
- Operational: we’ll enable a temporary extended quota and keep the same priority routing; SLOs unchanged
- Required: confirmation email from Lumigen to accept the date range

Option B — 150k token voucher (credits)
- Voucher covers 150,000 tokens of generation/embedding/reranking combined at the trial rate; voucher valid for 60 days from issuance
- Pricing: one-time voucher issuance; if you exceed voucher, normal trial rates apply
- Operational: no change to pilot dates; voucher is applied to overage at invoice time
- Required: signed addendum or signed quote (we can do DocuSign)

Engineering support: Vanessa can provision a temporary burst window (isolated capacity) for a 72-hour run if you want to do focused latency tests. That would require an SRE sync and a short runbook.

Next steps I suggest: 1) pick option A or B; 2) if B, confirm PO contact and we’ll send an addendum; 3) if A, confirm calendar window. I’ve attached usage snapshots to help you pick.

— Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
Attachment: POC_TopUp_Scenarios.pdf
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex@lumigen.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Gupta <priya@lumigen.com>
Date: 2026-12-03T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: short pilot extension or credit for burst testing

Alex / Priya — quick technical note on the burst window if you consider Option B (voucher + burst):
- We can spin an isolated burst job (dedicated pool) for up to 72 hours; it gives more consistent tail latency than a standard shared burst because it avoids noisy neighbors
- Prep work: we need a list of the dataset slices you'll run, and temporary credentials for the connector test environment.
- Logs and post-run analysis: we’ll provide token-level latency breakdowns and a short report within 48 hours of run completion.

I attached the usage snapshot (Lumigen_Usage_Snapshot.csv) — it shows your 95th/99th token latencies across current test runs; looks like you should be able to exercise the reranker within the voucher amount if you focus the run.

Happy to jump on a 30-min call to align on test window.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Attachment: Lumigen_Usage_Snapshot.csv
From: Alex Chen <alex@lumigen.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Gupta <priya@lumigen.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-04T16:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: short pilot extension or credit for burst testing

Thanks Sofia and Vanessa — after discussing with procurement, Lumigen will take Option B (150k token voucher) plus the 72-hour isolated burst run. Procurement would like a short addendum the team can sign today so we can move the PO through. Can you prepare a DocuSign-ready addendum that includes:
1) Voucher amount and expiration (150,000 tokens, 60 days)
2) Confirmation of the isolated 72-hour burst window and the post-run report deliverable (48 hours)
3) Billing: voucher applied to overages, no changes to pilot date (ends Dec 10)

Markus (cc) — please confirm if finance needs anything else on our side.

Sofia — if you send the addendum link I’ll get procurement to sign ASAP.

Best,
Alex
